title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C5.7 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 04:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 742 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

That wind is FAST! 🌫🚀👀

Solar imagery shows a compact sunspot group with bright active-region loops, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward-moving feature.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
